name: Propose reorders that keep service levels within stock targets
outcome: Reorder proposals hold the service level while lowering stock.
description: This outcome is the original minus its trailing clause, which said a planner approves most proposals without change. That clause was already a measure of this job (proposals accepted unchanged) and it is a number about the customer's own planners, measured after deployment, which no vendor can publish about someone else's staff. Nothing else about the job changed. Evidence is judged by measures, unchanged.
